# DeRoyal Hotspot OS - Full System Reference & Documentation

## Overview
DeRoyal Hotspot OS (https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/) provides complete infrastructure management for public and private Wi-Fi networks. It bridges client devices, captive portal pages, router gateways (such as MikroTik RouterOS), and backend billing/voucher systems.

## Domain Configuration
- Custom Domain: `deroyalhotspot.name.ng`
- Captive Portal Gateway URL: `https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/`
- Admin Operating System URL: `https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/admin`

## User Journey
1. Client connects to Wi-Fi SSID provided by DeRoyal Hotspot OS.
2. Router redirects browser to captive portal page `https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/` with MAC and IP parameters.
3. User enters a valid voucher code or selects a paid high-speed plan.
4. Portal validates voucher against backend API, registers device MAC address, and sends login instructions to MikroTik router gateway.
5. Client device receives instant internet access according to assigned bandwidth speed limits (Download/Upload queues).

## Admin Modules
- Dashboard: Real-time network statistics, connected user counter, revenue, router CPU/RAM health monitoring.
- Internet Plans: Configurable duration, pricing, and assigned bandwidth profiles.
- Bandwidth Profiles: Speed queues, rate limiting, and burst parameters.
- Vouchers: Batch voucher generation, exportable PDF/print vouchers, status tracking (Available, Used, Expired).
- Active Sessions: Live session termination, MAC authorization list, session duration timers.
- Audit Logs: Security events, admin sign-ins, router connection events, error trace logs.
- Settings: Custom domain binding, router IP/API credentials, branding options, and system backup.
